# snippetcheck

> snippetcheck extracts every TypeScript code block from a documentation site,
> installs the package the docs are about, type-checks each block against the real
> published type declarations, and reports only the samples that provably no longer
> work. Precision over recall: it never executes code, never guesses, and never
> reports a diagnostic it can't trace back to the target package's own `.d.ts`
> files. When in doubt, it stays silent and counts the snippet as skipped.

Run it against a docs site: `npx snippetcheck check <url-or-glob> --package <spec>`.

## Docs

- [CLI README](https://github.com/David19876543210/snippetcheck/blob/main/packages/cli/README.md): full usage, flags, exit codes, skip directives, prior art, and a real example run against a live docs site.
- [Repo README](https://github.com/David19876543210/snippetcheck/blob/main/README.md): workspace layout and development setup.

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/David19876543210/snippetcheck): CLI (`packages/cli`) and this site (`apps/web`), MIT licensed.
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/snippetcheck): `snippetcheck`.

## Verification records

Every finding this project publishes — in the README, on this site, and in its
hero demo — is real, unedited `snippetcheck` output, hand-verified against the live
docs it came from before publishing:

- [ai-sdk-verified.md](https://github.com/David19876543210/snippetcheck/blob/main/packages/cli/test/fixtures/ai-sdk-verified.md): every finding from the README's example run against the live Vercel AI SDK docs.
- [landing-page-verified.md](https://github.com/David19876543210/snippetcheck/blob/main/packages/cli/test/fixtures/landing-page-verified.md): every finding shown on this page.
